judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving its own `.lore/dod.md` checklist half-unchecked. While `ToolRegistry.register` and `ToolRegistry.execute` compile and validate static schemas with `ajv`, `register` compiles the schema once at registration time even for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource`s rather than resolving and caching per-call schemas via a `WeakMap` during `execute`. Only one unit test was added to `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (with four others placed in a non-standard `registry.acceptance.test.ts`), leaving out tests for extra properties passthrough, dynamic schema changes, static single-compilation, and unknown tool throws, as well as the required test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, the `execute` doc comment, or the `CHANGELOG.md` migration note were completed.
